name: breeding_ball
description: Green anaconda breeding ball in shallow water: one very fat female meandering through the middle (head up at the right), six thin males wrapped round her in loops (each passes behind and in front of her), their small heads poking out in different directions, same palette as green_anaconda. Writhing, not romantic. Water not drawn; pale ripple ring at the base. Anchor centre, ~720x280 (x -360..360, y -160..130). Top of the tangle around (0,-150) for the cap.
